verdict.rationale: The docs claim a voice assistant can be built and deployed in under 10 minutes, with a no-code Agent Builder and key-free LiveKit Inference for models. Hands-on probes confirm the framework and CLI install and run. Telephony support for inbound and outbound calls is documented, but it goes through SIP trunks, and nothing shows a phone number can be provisioned in-product or that a live phone call fits inside an hour. Missing for 10: in-product phone number provisioning, a documented phone-call quickstart with time-to-first-call, and hands-on or independent confirmation of a first live phone call.
